brief: Compare the Malaysian, Thai and Indian groups over the first half of 2026

sections.title: Competitor Comparison: Malaysian, Thai, and Indian Groups (1H 2026)
questions: How did the financial and operational performance of PETRONAS (Malaysia), PTT Global Chemical (Thailand), and Reliance Industries Limited (India) compare over the first half of 2026?
What were the key differences in revenue, profit, margins, and any notable operational events among these groups during this period?
Are there any differences in reporting currency, fiscal year, or adjusted measures that affect comparability?
sections.tool_rationale: Company filings are required to extract and compare financial and operational results, as well as to clarify reporting conventions and any adjustments made by each group.
sections.unanswerable_if: If one or more of the companies do not have filings covering the first half of 2026, or if the filings lack sufficient financial or operational detail for that period.

excluded.topic: Comparison with PETRONAS Chemicals Group (PCG) specifically
excluded.reason: The corpus only contains filings for the PETRONAS parent, not the listed chemicals subsidiary.
The brief is limited to the first half of 2026, which is fully historical and covered by the available filings.
